numerator_basis_proof: n1=4q+r, n2=3q+r, d=t, hence q=n1-n2 and r=4n2-3n1. The consume updates n1=(2k-1)n1+2n2, n2=(k-1)n1+(k+2)n2, d=(2k+1)d produce the same q=kq and r=(2q+r)(2k+1). Digit production updates each numerator by 10n-10digit*d. Both endpoint quotients remain real divisions.

algorithm.reason: Canonical sequential unbounded LFT spigot, permitted a>n impossible-candidate guard, both true endpoint divisions for every tested candidate, complete output and padding.

separate_r_fasta_review.findings: Hillis-Steele modular affine scan composes every output seed from the live incoming seed. Integer products and sums are below 2^35, exactly representable in binary64. All draws use seed/139968 and the original unscaled binary64 CDF. The last seed carries across chunks and from IUB into Human. No RNG period or output cache is used.
